# Builds the recompiled PowerPC code in ppc/ into a static library.
#
# ppc/ is generated by XenonRecomp and is gitignored — it does not exist in a
# fresh clone. Run the recompile first:
#
#   tools/XenonRecomp/build/XenonRecomp/XenonRecomp \
#       WoSRecompLib/config/WoS_config.toml \
#       tools/XenonRecomp/XenonUtils/ppc_context.h
#
# XenonRecomp emits a self-contained tree: ppc_config.h, ppc_context.h,
# ppc_recomp_shared.h, ppc_func_mapping.cpp and ppc_recomp.<N>.cpp. They
# include each other by plain name, so ppc/ itself is the only include
# directory needed beyond simde.

# Declared so this can be configured standalone (tools/build_ppc.sh does
# exactly that) as well as via add_subdirectory from the root.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project("WoSRecompLib" CXX)

set(PPC_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ppc")

file(GLOB PPC_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${PPC_DIR}/*.cpp")

if(NOT PPC_SOURCES)
    message(WARNING
        "WoSRecompLib: no generated sources in ${PPC_DIR}. "
        "Run XenonRecomp first (see this file's header). Skipping target.")
    return()
endif()

list(LENGTH PPC_SOURCES PPC_SOURCE_COUNT)
message(STATUS "WoSRecompLib: ${PPC_SOURCE_COUNT} generated source file(s)")

add_library(WoSRecompLib STATIC ${PPC_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(WoSRecompLib
    PUBLIC
        "${PPC_DIR}"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tools/XenonRecomp/thirdparty/simde"
)

target_compile_features(WoSRecompLib PUBLIC cxx_std_20)

# The generated code uses simde intrinsics that need SSE4.1 and above —
# simde_mm_round_ps in particular, emitted by vrfin/vrfiz/vrfip. Sandybridge
# (AVX) is what XenonTests targets, so match it.
#
# clang-cl takes MSVC-style flags, so -march has to be passed through with
# /clang: there; everything else takes it directly.
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    target_compile_options(WoSRecompLib PRIVATE /clang:-march=sandybridge)
else()
    target_compile_options(WoSRecompLib PRIVATE -march=sandybridge)
endif()

# Recompiled code is machine-generated: unused labels and variables are
# normal and expected, not something to fix. Silencing them keeps real
# diagnostics visible in a build this large.
target_compile_options(WoSRecompLib PRIVATE
    -Wno-unused-label
    -Wno-unused-variable
    -Wno-unused-but-set-variable
    -Wno-unused-function
)
